responsibility: Defines GCC’s x86 FMA intrinsic header for the standard three-operand fused multiply-add instruction set. It conditionally enables the fma target feature and provides inline wrappers for packed and scalar fmadd, fmsub, fnmadd, fnmsub, fmaddsub, and fmsubadd operations on 128-bit and 256-bit float and double vectors, serving as the public API layer for the mainstream FMA ISA rather than AMD’s separate FMA4 form.
